title: Terms of Use
description: Terms for using the official website of Dr. Patience Ishaku Abbo, including use of photographs and content.
body:
**Last updated: 12 November 2026**

Welcome to the official website of Dr. Patience Ishaku Abbo. By using this website, you agree to these Terms of Use.

## Use of this website

This website shares information about the life, work and public engagements of Dr. Patience Ishaku Abbo, including her biography, awards, publications, news and photographs. You may browse, read and share links to any page for personal and non commercial purposes.

## Photographs and content

All text, photographs, logos and other content on this website belong to Dr. Patience Ishaku Abbo or are used with permission.

- **Media use:** journalists and news organisations may use photographs from the Gallery for news reporting, provided they credit **"Office of Dr. Patience Ishaku Abbo"** and do not alter them in a misleading way.
- **Other uses:** any other use, including advertising, merchandise or political materials, requires written permission. Email us to ask.
- The **PIA na SIA** name and logo may not be used in a way that suggests endorsement without permission.

## Links to other websites

This website links to other websites, such as Woman to Woman Network 21 and social media platforms. We are not responsible for the content or practices of those websites.

## Accuracy of information

We work to keep the information on this website accurate and up to date, but it is provided "as is" for general information only. We may change or remove content at any time without notice.

## Limitation of liability

To the fullest extent permitted by law, we are not liable for any loss or damage arising from your use of this website or from relying on its content.

## Governing law

These Terms are governed by the laws of the Federal Republic of Nigeria.

## Contact

For questions about these Terms or to request permission to use content, email **message@patienceishakuabbo.com**.
